about: The tractus of the formulary “Immaculate Heart of the Blessed Virgin Mary” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Now therefore, children, listen to me: blessed are those who keep my ways. Hear instruction and be wise, and do not reject it. Blessed is the man who hears me, and who watches daily at my gates, and waits at the posts of my door. Whoever finds me will find life, and will draw salvation from the Lord.
